summary: Iteration 18 full-stack verification: (1) Homepage featured section — after a warm/second load renders with SOLD banner + hero card; details column IS removed (dash-featured-address/stats/description all absent); hero is 16:9 (ratio 1.778 at both 1920 and 390) and horizontally centered (left_gap=right_gap=318px inside its section at 1920, max width 960px); video play/close toggles the iframe. (2) Luxury /specialties/luxury film frame is 16:9 (1168×657, ratio 1.778) and clicking it loads luxury-film-iframe. (3) Equestrian landing shows stat-total=974, 7 hero rotation dots (photos>=6 satisfied by the 6-photo trim), 4 sample-* cards; region chip Fraser Valley navigates to /listings?city=…&property_type=Equestrian and cards paint in ~1.32s (68 cards). (4) /listings, /listings?property_type=Equestrian, /listings?city=Surrey all render 54–68 cards. (5) Backend suite (6 tests, all passing): /api/listings?limit=24 trims photos<=6 with photo_count present; /api/listings/equestrian trims photos; equestrian filters+region_chip=200; second cached /api/listings?property_type=Equestrian call was slightly faster; /api/listings/{key} returns the FULL untrimmed photos array (>6). (6) All 9 lazy admin routes plus /compare?demo=1 render real content — no blank pages, no ChunkLoadError, no console errors about undefined components.

ui_bugs.issue: On the very first cold navigation to /, [data-testid=dash-featured-listing] failed to appear within a 20s wait; it only rendered after a page reload (verified twice). Once rendered it is perfect (16:9 hero, centered, no details column, SOLD banner present, video toggle works). Likely a first-paint / data-fetch race between the featured listing fetch and the parent SearchPanel mounting the child. Users hitting the homepage cold may briefly not see the featured card. Not a regression from this iteration's spec but worth noting.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why /specialties homepage's dash-featured-listing does not paint on the first cold navigation but does after a reload — possibly guard the render on a fetched state rather than requiring the parent SearchPanel to fully mount, or add SSR fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: React warning still logged on every homepage load: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — an somewhere (equestrian hero eager change per spec) is using lowercase attribute in JSX. Change fetchpriority="high" to fetchPriority="high" to silence the console error.

Hydration warning on homepage: <span> is being rendered inside <option> in DashboardMockup.jsx around line 3006 (the beds/baths select). Wrap the numeric label in {n} directly instead of a <span> to avoid the React hydration warning.
Some resources 410 Gone in console on homepage — likely stale preloaded assets; safe to ignore but noisy.
